jobs.title: Temporary Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Why Join JVS?**


JVS is a nonprofit working to close opportunity gaps in employment by supporting jobseekers with the skills and confidence to secure quality careers with family\-sustaining wages. Grounded in core values of repairing the world and focused on helping our program participants achieve economic mobility, we believe everyone deserves access to training and the chance for a good job. JVS develops training programs in close partnership with employers in high growth sectors, offering high quality jobs.


Building on decades of experience and success, JVS is a data\-driven organization that takes a whole systems approach to addressing employment and economic equity. Through our direct service programs, employer engagement and policy change, JVS is working toward a future where everyone has access to quality education and training programs that lead to high quality employment and economic mobility.  

  

**Job Summary:**


The Temporary Program Coordinator plays a pivotal role in supporting participants throughout their enrollment and career development journeys. This position ensures accurate assessment, application review, and data management, while also providing personalized coaching and guidance.  

The role involves participating in program orientations, developing career action plans, monitoring participant progress, and collaborating with internal teams and external partners. Success is measured by the ability to meet enrollment and cohort targets, support participant retention, and foster positive outcomes in career placement. A strong commitment to equity, inclusion, and excellent customer service is essential. This role is full\-time, limited\-term, and anticipated to end on 06/30/2027\.

**Responsibilities:**

**Application \& Assessment**

* Review and evaluate program applications for candidate suitability.
* Coordinate and participate in interviews using established criteria to determine participant qualifications.
* Enter and maintain accurate participant records and assessment data in Salesforce or similar systems.

**Program Orientation \& Coaching*** Participate in orientations to introduce participants to program expectations, resources, and support services.
* Provide ongoing coaching and feedback to guide candidates through enrollment and career development.

**Participant Journey Management*** Track and monitor participant progress through career action plans and program milestones.
* Meet regularly with participants during their course and job search phases.
* Refer participants to external services for barriers beyond program scope.

**Support \& Engagement**

* Maintain positive connections among participants, staff, and cohorts.
* Process participant resource dollars and support access to necessary resources.
* Inform participants about their progress and required actions to advance.

**Administrative \& Data Management**

* Document participant encounters and barriers in Salesforce.
* Manage schedules to ensure participants stay on track with program and job search timelines.
* Collaborate with partner agencies and other program staff to ensure effective communication with participants and across agencies.
* Complete administrative projects in support of the Program Team.

**Performance Monitoring**

* Track participant outcomes and support progress toward sustainable wage careers.
* Monitor and encourage the application of behavioral skills in classroom and workplace settings.

**Qualifications:**

* 1–3 years of experience in a similar role.
* Experience working with diverse populations and a demonstrated commitment to equity and inclusion.
* Proven ability to help individuals achieve career or educational goals.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and record\-keeping.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ability to learn Salesforce or similar CRM systems.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills for building rapport with participants and stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and time management skills to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
* Ability to analyze participant needs and develop personalized action plans.
* Competence in documenting and tracking participant progress using CRM systems.
* Strong problem\-solving skills to address participant barriers and critical incidents.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team and with external partners.
* Flexibility and adaptability to meet changing organizational and participant needs.
* High degree of initiative, integrity, and professionalism.
* Commitment to the mission and values of JVS.
* Positive attitude and genuine desire to help participants succeed.


**What We Offer*** $3,062\.50 per pay period
* 100% covered medical and dental plans for the employee
* Accrued sixteen (16\) days of Vacation \+ accrued ten (10\) days of Paid Sick Leave
* Paid federal and Jewish holidays
* 3% 403(b) retirement contribution match and 3% non\-elective contribution
* Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA
* Pet Insurance Discounts
* Employee Assistance Program
* The expectation for this role is to work in our San Francisco office and/or worksites on a hybrid work schedule; JVS does not provide relocation packages
* 4 Day Work Week

We welcome diverse applicants. Please let us know if you need accommodations or auxiliary aids for the interview process.*

jobs.description:
**Join our team and make a difference in people’s lives!**

We're looking for a **Program Coordinator** for the **San Jose, CA area!**

**Specifics:**

* **Official Job Title:** Program Coordinator
* **Job classification:** Non\-Exempt, 10 hours per week
* **Job Location:** San Jose, CA
* **Pay rate:** $21\.00 ph
* **Skills:** Experience working with youth ages 5 through 17; small\- and large\-group classroom management skills; excellent communication and organizational abilities.

**Our Philosophy**

**LifeSTEPS** is committed to build thriving communities by empowering individuals and families through supportive housing and services. The **STEP** in **LifeSTEPS** stands for “**S**kills **T**raining and **E**ducational **P**rograms” and is the heart of our mission. We believe community development is built “One STEP at a time.” Our vision is that every person served by LifeSTEPS will be empowered with the skills, resources, and support to maintain stable housing and break the cycle of poverty. Our founders believe that building affordable housing is only the first step. It is also essential to provide meaningful programs that empower people to move forward in their lives.




**About us**


LifeSTEPS, is a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit charitable organization. It was founded in 1996 and currently has over 440 partnered affordable housing properties all over the state of California. We serve several regions from Sacramento, Bay Area, South Bay, Central Valley, LA County and Inland Pacific regions. We work with 115,000 residents all over the state and we’re on a mission to provide effective educational and supportive services to maximize the strengths of individuals and build resilient communities.




**Our Benefits**


In addition to meeting your passion for making a difference in the lives of those we serve, all employees will receive the following benefits:

* Competitive pay based on skill and experience
* Paid Holidays
* Paid Sick Leave
* Employee Assistance Program
* LifeSTEPS Perks Program


Benefit eligible employees working 30 hours per week or more will also receive:

* Medical, Dental Vision, and Life Insurance
* 401(k) plan
* Identity Theft Program
* Pet Insurance
* Paid Time Off




**About the Position**


The **Program Coordinator,** under the direction of the Regional Director of Social Services, is expected to design, implement, and coordinate activities and programs within assigned affordable housing complexes. This position works closely with the Director of Social Services (DSS) to provide the highest quality of service to the residents served by LifeSTEPS.




**Core Duties** **Program Coordinator**


* Empower children from low\-income and underserved families to flourish by providing after\-school education and resources.
* Ensure our young individuals a caring and safe place to go after school to get assistance with homework and academic enrichment.
* Encourage children to thrive and become empowered so they can develop into resilient adults.

**Education and/or Experience and/or License Certification:**

* High School Diploma or equivalent.
* Two (2\) years of experience in a similar environment providing services.
* Bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology, or related field preferred.
* Valid California Driving License and reliable, insured transportation required




Are you ready to make a difference, stand behind and support individuals and families so they achieve their goals and become empowered to move forward in their lives? Apply today!!!

***LifeSTEPS values the diversity of the people it hires and serves. Diversity at LifeSTEPS means fostering a workplace in which individual differences are recognized, appreciated, respected, and responded to in ways that fully develop and utilize each person's talents and strengths. YouTube Biz Segment GTM is responsible for designing and delivering our service models for our Business Development, Creator and Consumer Success, and Partner Engineering teams to drive sustainable partner growth and customer lifetime value. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


The Devices and Services Supply Chain Planning team ensures Google’s hardware products reach users globally with high availability and optimal operational efficiency. Within this organization, the Accessories End\-to\-End Planning team oversees the full lifecycle planning, supply\-demand balancing, and fulfillment strategy for Google’s first\-party and third\-party accessories portfolio spanning Made by Google and Made for Google ecosystems (e.g., Pixel Watch bands, cases, chargers, audio, and partner accessories).

This is an exciting and growing space at Google supporting a large range of categories and products across our Made by Google and Made for Google ecosystems (e.g., Pixel Watch bands, cases, chargers, audio, and partner accessories).


Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. Our Devices \& Services team combines the best of Google AI, Software, and Hardware to create radically helpful experiences for users. We research, design, and develop new technologies and hardware to make our user's interaction with computing faster, seamless, and more powerful. Whether finding new ways to capture and sense the world around us, advancing form factors, or improving interaction methods, the Devices \& Services team is making people's lives better through technology.

**Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!**


Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world\-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.


Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi\-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Operations
jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode \- pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting\-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.  



**Our Team**
------------

Netflix’s Content \& Business Products (CBP) department builds and buys technology that helps create, plan, produce, promote, and distribute the content our subscribers enjoy on the Netflix streaming service. We partner with cross\-functional teams to develop cutting\-edge solutions that are revolutionizing the entertainment industry.


The Product Directors \& Managers in CBP need to (1\) plan, prioritize, and execute across multiple product domains; (2\) align with multiple sets of business stakeholders; and (3\) connect their work to the broader product organization. To support these three altitudes of work, the CBP Operations team provides tactical support to relieve operational overhead.


CBP Programs \& Ops strives for consistency via comprehensive support to our product domain leaders and product managers. Our mission is to enhance operational efficiency by centralizing and managing essential resources, fostering effective communication, and exploring innovative technology solutions. To achieve our mission we develop operating models tailored to the product domains we support, helping to provide them with tools and insights needed for our dynamic environment – this foundational work helps us build towards a cohesive operating model for the CBP department.  



**The Role**
------------

jobs.description:
**About Clipboard**
===================


Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app\-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

  

Founded in 2016, we are a remote\-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y\-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022\. We’re the leader in Long\-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

**The Role**
------------


Clipboard Health is a marketplace that connects healthcare facilities with professionals looking for shifts.


Our largest customers operate at significant scale, and their problems don't always fit neatly into a single team or function. A product implementation might stall because of an operational workflow. A payroll issue might involve the customer, our Operations team, Product, and Engineering. An integration might technically work but fail to work for the people actually using it.


We need someone who can step into those situations and figure them out.


As a **Forward Deployed Operations Manager**, you'll work directly with some of our most important enterprise customers to solve complex operational and product problems. You'll get close to the customer, understand how their business actually works, diagnose what's going wrong, and coordinate the people needed to fix it.


You won't necessarily have direct authority over the teams doing the work. Instead, you'll create clarity, build alignment, and keep things moving.

**Your job is to take a messy problem and turn it into a solved problem.**


Some days that might mean analyzing data to understand why a customer's staffing workflow isn't working. Other days might involve coordinating a complex implementation across Product, Engineering, and Operations, troubleshooting a payroll or time clock issue, or working with a customer's leadership team to get a stalled initiative back on track.


The problems will change. The expectation won't: **you own the outcome.**

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own complex customer and operational problems from diagnosis through resolution
* Work directly with enterprise customers to understand their workflows, challenges, and goals
* Build relationships with customer stakeholders ranging from frontline operators to VP and Director\-level leaders
* Diagnose problems by combining customer conversations, operational context, data, and system behavior
* Break ambiguous problems into clear workstreams, priorities, owners, and timelines
* Lead complex customer implementations, particularly involving time clock compliance, payroll, and integrations with systems like ADP and UKG
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to investigate issues, define solutions, and drive execution
* Coordinate across Product, Engineering, Operations, and customer teams to remove blockers and keep critical initiatives moving
* Manage expectations and communicate clearly when timelines, priorities, or solutions change
* Identify recurring operational and customer problems and turn those insights into improvements to our product and processes
* Build new processes or approaches when existing ones aren't sufficient to solve the problem
* Travel to customer sites occasionally when being there in person will help move an important problem or implementation forward

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 2–6 years of experience in consulting, operations, strategy and operations, implementation, customer strategy, program management, or a similar problem\-solving role
* Experience working directly with customers or clients, particularly in complex or high\-stakes situations
* Strong structured problem\-solving skills. You can take an ambiguous problem, figure out what matters, and create a path forward
* Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to investigate problems and make decisions
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both senior executives and frontline operators
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence teams without direct authority
* Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple workstreams, priorities, and stakeholders simultaneously
* A strong sense of ownership. You care about the ultimate outcome, not just completing your assigned tasks
* Curious and resourceful. You're comfortable learning new systems, processes, and industries quickly
* Persistent when things get messy. You don't give up when the first solution doesn't work
* Comfortable getting into the weeds. You'll need to understand operational details, systems, data, and processes to solve many of the problems you'll encounter

**Consulting backgrounds are a particularly strong fit**, especially candidates who have experience working with complex clients, structuring ambiguous problems, and driving cross\-functional projects. We're also open to candidates from operations, implementation, product, program management, and other backgrounds with the same core skill set.


We're looking for people who are ready to move beyond simply identifying problems or making recommendations. You want to be the person responsible for making the solution work.

**Location**

This is an onsite role based in our San Francisco office for \~2 days per week. We're also open to candidates who are willing to relocate to the Bay Area.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**  

Spectro Cloud helps platform teams and cloud providers modernize and manage infrastructure for the AI era without adding more tools or operational complexity.


With PaletteAI, enterprises, public sector organizations, neoclouds and sovereign clouds can build, govern and operate full\-stack environments across VMs, Kubernetes, edge, regulated and air\-gapped locations, and AI infrastructure. PaletteAI Launchpads help teams start quickly with urgent outcomes such as VMware migration, token cost control or edge modernization, then scale into enterprise\-wide lifecycle management, governance and fleet operations on the same platform.

**About the Team**  

Marketing at Spectro Cloud runs fast, and the systems underneath need to keep up. We're hiring our first dedicated Senior Marketing Operations Manager to own the plumbing that makes everything work — the workflows, the data, the leads, the nurtures, and the reporting that leadership and the board rely on. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role reporting to the Director of Demand Gen. You'll be the person who makes marketing operations a durable, well\-architected system that scales with the business. You'll partner closely with demand generation, field marketing, web, sales, and RevOps, and you'll have a direct line into how pipeline gets built, measured, and reported.
  

  

**What You'll Do**
  

Lead flow, system architecture, and automation
* Own how leads move through HubSpot and into Salesforce end\-to\-end
* Build and maintain campaign workflows
* Manage HubSpot Salesforce integration, field mapping, and lifecycle stage handoffs
* Add and maintain the properties needed for routing, reporting, and sales visibility
* Troubleshoot sync errors and process breakdowns as they arise

  

Campaign and event operations
* Manage landing pages, forms, and campaign assets in HubSpot
* Upload and process event lead lists; route qualified leads into the right nurture sequences
* QA campaign setup end\-to\-end — from lead capture through Salesforce sync
* Ensure lead source and channel tracking is consistent, complete, and reportable across trade shows, website, SEO, social, ABM, and paid programs

  

Data quality and system maintenance
* Own the ongoing integrity of marketing data.
* Monitor and resolve sync errors, incomplete records, and misrouted leads
* Investigate individual records when qualification, source, or history is questioned
* Own and enforce a consistent cross\-team UTM structure for digital campaigns

  

Lead scoring and lifecycle management
* Maintain and continuously improve the lead scoring and qualification model used by Marketing and Sales

 Ensure lifecycle stage definitions are clear, consistently applied, and aligned with how Sales works leads Nurture operations Build and maintain nurture programs in HubSpot, including entry/exit logic and progression rules
* Monitor performance and report on whether programs are actually moving leads forward
* Manage one off email sends for event invitation/follow up etc.

  

Reporting, dashboards, and attribution
* Build the reporting foundation for pipeline sourced and influenced by marketing, by source and channel
* Deliver campaign ROI reporting: target, actual, and attainment
* Maintain separate reporting views for Commercial and Public Sector
* Produce quarterly board\-ready reporting, including sourced/attributed vs. assisted/influenced, open vs. closed\-won, and created\-in\-quarter vs. trailing
* Develop a first version of a multi\-touch attribution model, and iterate from there

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

* 6\+ years in marketing operations at a B2B SaaS company, with at least 2–3 years at a senior/lead level in a builder role.
* Long term strategic thinker with a builder mindset.
* Deep, hands\-on HubSpot expertise — workflows, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, custom properties, sync management, settings. You should be able to open HubSpot on day one and know exactly where to look.
* Strong working knowledge of Salesforce and of the HubSpot–Salesforce integration specifically (field mapping, sync rules, common failure modes)
* Experience owning lead routing, lifecycle management, and lead scoring end\-to\-end
* Track record of building nurture programs that actually move pipeline
* Comfort with attribution — multi\-touch models, sourced vs. influenced, and the tradeoffs between them
* Strong data instincts: you notice when numbers don't add up, and you know how to trace them back to the source
* Excellent communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills — this role sits at the seam between Marketing, Sales, and RevOps
* Comfortable operating autonomously in a fast\-moving, less\-than\-fully\-built environment
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Hands on experience with ABM platforms (6Sense, DemandBase), intent data tools, lead routing (LeanData)
* HubSpot Marketing Software and/or Salesforce Administrator certifications
* Experience building marketing ops from an early stage rather than inheriting a mature stack

  

Location: This role is hybrid in San Jose, CA. We are in office 3x a week, 2x WFH.  

Remote candidates in the Bay Area and in US will still be considered for this role.  

  

The On\-Target Earnings for this role is $142,500\-$195,500 \+ Equity.

jobs.title: Operations Manager (Transportation)
jobs.description:
Hallcon is a mobility and infrastructure services company focused on turnkey solutions for clients such as technology companies, manufacturers, railroads, universities, corporate business parks, hospitals, airports, public transportation agencies and more.
  
  

The Company provides essential transportation services including multi\-mode operations, integrated command centers, electric vehicle (EV) infrastructure, technology, analytics and business intelligence, maintenance, cleaning, and rider experience measurement. For more information, visit hallcon.com.
  
  

Position Overview
  
The Operations Manager reports directly to the General Manager (GM). This position helps the GM manage the day\-to\-day operations as part of the employee transportation program for our client at the San Francisco International Airport.
  
  

The Operations Manager is primarily responsible for the management of the employee workforce including but not limited to timekeeping, drafting and issuing disciplinary action, and administrative and operational training and oversight.
  
  

The Operations Manager will assist the GM in maintaining an effective working relationship with the client, the employees, multiple unions and other vendors.
  
  

Essential Job Responsibilities
  
Operational
  
Meet or exceed all Client expectations. This includes managing performance to the elements of the Scope of Work (SOW) and Service Level Agreements (SLA) applicable to the Operations Manager’s position.
  
  

Make sure all routes/runs are performed in a timely manner. Make sure the driver team has updated information on runs/routes to be covered, and have had hands\-on training for new routes, with turn\-by\-turn documentation. Drivers should be fully aware of factors that may cause delays when operating a new route. Be aware of all schedules and routes; oversee coverage, uncovered routes due to absences, or shifts not covered. Make sure alternatives are in place to respond to call outs, vehicle breakdowns, traffic conditions, etc.
  
  

**Create and manage an effective driver team:**  

Maintain a proficient extra board driving team to cover the assigned routes as necessary.
  
Make sure that drivers are compliant with all client and Hallcon requirements for:
  
* Performance
* Conduct
* Timeliness
* Attire


Must work very closely with Dispatch. Obtain latest information on driver and/or route coverage issues or other impacting transit delays. Must also be able to cover dispatch in instances of callouts. Monitor passenger complaints and service issues and report those issues to GM. Answer all email and phone inquiries in a timely and accurate manner.
  
  

Safety \& Compliance
  
Ensure Safety and Compliance, working with Safety Manager. Make sure all operational activities are conducted safely, in compliance with all applicable Federal, State and Local laws and regulations, and in accordance to Hallcon policies and guidelines. Making sure that all safety\-related information (accidents, incidents) is reported to the Client, and Safety Manager, in a timely manner.
  
  

Leadership
  
Be a motivational leader. Make sure that the drivers have an opportunity to share their views on a routine basis. Communicate driver’s views and questions to the ADO and the Hallcon Senior Leadership Team without filter or prejudice. Be empathetic to driver’s views; follow up on all driver issues in a timely manner. Keep your commitments to drivers. Control absenteeism and tardiness by consistently administering the attendance policy.
  
  

Promote passenger satisfaction. Monitor, and act upon, passenger complaints and service issues. Make sure that service alerts and notifications are generated and distributed promptly. Must make sure that drivers handle all passenger interactions in a courteous and professional manner.
  
  

Manage documentation and reports. This includes elements the Daily Activity Report (DAR), Ridership Report, and Accident \& Incident Log. Upon the direction of the GM, generate other client\-specific data or QBR related statistics. Designate and oversee personnel responsible for the creation and communication of daily KFI reports. And any other requested data/analytics collection and finalized reports.
  
Collaborate with GM to foster a relationship with union business agents and participate in union activities including, Contract Negotiations, Grievance, and assist in the preparation and implementation of shift and vacation bids.
  
  

Human Resources
  
Work with GM and Human Resources to forecast recruiting needs for employees. Maintain a file (electronic or hard copy) for all employees; add performance data with date and time, to aid in awarding incentives, performance reviews, corrective or disciplinary actions. Engage team members and promote job satisfaction. Make sure employees get the rest and meal periods as required by law.
  
Other duties as assigned
  
  

Education/Experience/Requirements
  
* Must have a minimum of 2 years of experience in managing customer service and in promoting and enhancing client relations.
* Must have a minimum of 5 years’ management experience in transportation/logistics including managing a large (50\+) driver team.
* Requires experience with FMCS regulations as prescribed by the US Department of Transportation.
* Must be able to work flexible hours as required, including weekends.
* Must have the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Must have excellent communications skills in English, including written communications and presentations.
* Ability to learn specialized programs (GPS\-based systems, operation of security cameras, plug\-in regenerative units, vehicle and driver database management program, generate reports on ridership counts, trends, etc.
* Must have intermediate computer skills and have experience with Microsoft Office
* Must set an example as a leader. This includes work ethics, work hours, attire, attitude, interpersonal communications, timelines

jobs.title: Operations Manager for Superconducting Device Fabrication Facility
jobs.description:
Job Overview
  
  

You are invited to apply for the position of Operations Manager for the Detector Microfabrication Facility (DMF) in the Fundamental Physics Directorate (FPD) at SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory. The Operations Manager is responsible for directing the operation of the DMF cleanroom and supporting technical systems (e.g. deposition and fabrication tools, tool utilities, metrology laboratory) to enable the fabrication of state\-of\-the\-art superconducting microelectronics devices in the DMF to support SLAC’s scientific mission. To fulfill this responsibility the Operations Manager has the authority to:
  
  

Manage the DMF and associated external facilities.
  
  

Hire and manage the DMF staff including engineers and technicians.
  
  

Implement the process controls, operations procedures, and training standards for all DMF work.
  
  

Manage the allocation of DMF resources.
  
  

Work with the DMF Director and their team to ensure DMF serves the needs of its users
  
  

The Detector Microfabrication Facility (DMF) is an ISO\-5 cleanroom with a dedicated toolset for the R\&D and at\-scale production of superconducting devices and sensors with high uniformity, complexity, yield, and reproducibility. In addition to a specialized toolset on 150mm wafers, the DMF also includes necessary capabilities for post\-fabrication metrology, room\-temperature and cryogenic characterization, and validation of functionality and performance of devices produced at the DMF. The facility is envisioned to support DOE mission science by enabling collaborative research across universities, labs and industry in quantum information science and fundamental physics. The DMF is managed by the Fundamental Physics Directorate (FPD). The FPD brings together scientists and technologies that support national priorities in particle physics, astrophysics and cosmology to explore the basic particles and forces that knit the cosmos together. As a key member of the DMF management team, you will report to the DMF Director.
  
  

**Your specific responsibilities will include:**  

Management of all operations in the Detector Microfabrication Facility; cleanroom, tool suite, and metrology lab.
  
  

Support of the scientific user base in optimizing device fabrication, while maintaining stringent standards for core process stability and purity.
  
  

Support of SLAC leadership in the strategic and financial planning for the DMF.
  
  

Scheduling and coordination all work in the DMF.
  
  

Management of the online portal(s) for tool status and reserving/logging of tool usage and operator hours.
  
  

Hiring and management of the DMF core team (tool engineers, process engineers and technicians). Work with the Scientific Direction to help build a team of device scientists to complement the operations team.
  
  

Building SLAC's values (excellence, integrity, collaboration, respect, and creativity), and safety into every aspect of the DMF core team’s work and culture.
  
  

Engagement of matrixed SLAC staff or external contracted resources where appropriate to augment DMF core staff.
  
  

Assuring that all DMF operations are performed safely and in compliance with SLAC, Stanford, and Government requirements and regulations, in collaboration with SLAC Environment, Safety \& Health (ESH) staff.
  
  

Establish and communicate to staff and users the safety protocols for use of the facility and its tools, coordinating with ESH as necessary.
  
  

Establish the qualifications and training requirements for staff and users to access and work in the DMF facility.
  
  

Develop and manage the DMF\-specific staff and user training.
  
  

Plan tool acceptance activities and develop procedures for tool startup and commissioning when new tools are introduced to the facility. Maintain standard operating procedures for facility tools including deposition, etching, lithography and metrology tools and wet benches.
  
  

Plan and manage the maintenance of DMF tools (e.g., lithography, etching, deposition, wet benches, SRDs) coordinating preventative maintenance schedules and servicing. Procure maintenance contracts for the major fabrication tools.
  
  

Plan and manage the maintenance of DMF subsystems (e.g., ultra\-pure water, process vacuum, utility nitrogen, acid waste neutralization) coordinating preventative maintenance schedules and servicing. Coordinate with Facilities \& Operations (F\&O) on the development and execution of regular cleanroom maintenance of F\&O\-managed systems and utilities. Procure maintenance contracts where appropriate.
  
  

Plan and manage the maintenance of DMF metrology tools (e.g., dilution refrigerator) coordinating preventative maintenance schedules and servicing. Procure maintenance contracts where appropriate.
  
  

Maintain cleanroom materials catalogs and documentation and establish protocols for safe handling of materials and waste; maintain stock of common cleanroom supplies and consumables.
  
  

**To be successful in this position you will bring:**  

Demonstrated excellence in leading disciplined operations at a research cleanroom facility.
  
  

Bachelor’s degree with 8 years of relevant experience in a science or engineering discipline relevant to the DMF’s mission in performing the above listed duties.
  
  

Experience fostering an environment that cultivates innovation and groundbreaking R\&D while simultaneously ensuring delivery to sponsors and projects.
  
  

Experience working in an environment dedicated to quality, safety and customer service.
  
  

Ability to negotiate mutually beneficial outcomes, manage conflict, and motivate others to action.

* Coordinate with Fleet Operations on day\-to\-day robot allocation for training
* Escalate performance findings to the program lead and to hardware/software engineering


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

* 1\-2 years of experience in an operations, program\-support, or offshore\-workforce role (recruiting, training, or performance tracking)
* Comfort working from SOPs and following a defined process closely
* Strong data\-analysis skills and comfort with messy real\-world data
* Clear written and verbal communication skills
* Willingness to work hard in a scrappy environment

  

We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive team. At Watney Robotics, we welcome people of all backgrounds and identities, and we make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential. If you’re passionate about robotics but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply!

==========================


Follow us here on**X**and**LinkedIn**

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Client Delivery
jobs.description:
**Vivodyne creates human data before clinical trials.**
-------------------------------------------------------



We accelerate the successful discovery, design, and development of human therapeutics by testing on large, lab\-grown human organ tissues at massive scale, driving technological advancement at the convergence of novel biology, robotics, and AI. We identify and validate new therapeutic targets and de\-risk new therapeutic assets by producing clinically translatable multi\-omic data from our proprietary, physiologically\-realistic human organ tissues at unprecedented scale, speed, and quality. This enables us to produce more human data than all clinical trials in the U.S. combined. We’re financially backed by some of the most selective and successful venture funds, and we have already partnered with a majority of the top 10 multinational pharmaceutical companies to discover and develop better, safer drugs and dramatically reduce the burden of animal testing.



www.vivodyne.com


**Role**
--------



Vivodyne is seeking a **Senior Program Manager, Client Delivery** to lead the operational delivery of complex client programs across Vivodyne’s scientific, technical, and commercial teams. This person will serve as a primary internal coordinator and, for assigned accounts, a client\-facing program lead. They will translate work plans into executable schedules, maintain clear communication, surface risks early, and ensure delivery commitments remain visible across teams.



This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in San Francisco, working closely with a bicoastal delivery team, with occasional travel to our Philadelphia site.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


#### **Client Engagement \& Delivery**


* **Own end\-to\-end delivery for a portfolio of complex client programs**, accountable for delivering against agreed scope, timelines, budget, and client commitments from kickoff and work\-plan alignment through execution, data delivery, closeout, and subsequent phases. Programs may span multiple technical workstreams, sites, external partners, and extended timelines.
* **Act as a consistent client\-facing program lead** for assigned accounts, establishing communication cadence, coordinating key decisions and follow\-ups, providing clear status updates, and raising schedule or deliverable risks early.
* **Lead client kickoff and delivery planning**, ensuring work plans, dependencies, ownership, collaboration workflows, and legal or operational prerequisites are aligned before execution.
* **Coordinate data and documentation delivery**, establishing clear expectations, ownership, and timelines for technical reports, assay and methods documentation, data packages, presentations, and client communications.

#### **Internal Stakeholder Alignment \& Resource Management**


* **Build and maintain integrated program plans** covering milestones, dependencies, study schedules, resources, owners, risks, and delivery dates, providing practical execution guidance when programs compete for shared resources.
* **Coordinate cross\-functional execution** across biology, operations, microfabrication, hardware/software, data analysis, business development, and leadership. Translate program objectives and requirements into clear internal context, decisions, and next steps.
* **Manage scope, capacity, and schedule trade\-offs**, identifying constraints across resource availability, product readiness, staffing, materials, technical development, client requirements, and operational capacity; facilitate decisions and communicate their implications.
* **Run portfolio\-level delivery operating rhythms**, including weekly reviews and leadership updates that surface priorities, risks, decisions, and cross\-team dependencies.
* **Maintain a reliable system for program and portfolio management**, ensuring project plans, ownership, dependencies, risks, and status remain current and visible across teams.

#### **Strategy \& Operational Excellence**


* **Coordinate internal R\&D and tissue roadmap execution** in partnership with biology and product leads, translating scientific priorities into executable plans, milestones, and timelines. Balance internal model and capability development with client delivery commitments.
* **Partner with BD and leadership on feasibility, resourcing, pricing, and delivery planning** for prospective and expanding client work, helping evaluate scope alternatives, timelines, cost inputs, and operational feasibility.
* **Improve delivery processes and knowledge transfer** by documenting repeatable workflows, clarifying ownership, creating training materials, and ensuring critical program and account knowledge is transferable across the team.
* **Lead and champion program management best practices**, creating consistent ways of working across teams for planning, execution, risk management, communication, and delivery

### **What success looks like**


* Client programs are delivered against agreed scope, timelines, budget, and client commitments, with deviations proactively managed and communicated.
* Clients have a clear, reliable view of milestones, deliverables, owners, and changes.
* Internal teams understand the scientific and commercial context of their work.
* Risks and dependency conflicts are identified and addressed early, with explicit options and decisions.
* Program plans reflect reliable data and actual operational capacity rather than only desired timelines.
* Data, methods, and client\-facing materials are delivered in an organized, predictable way.
* Program knowledge is well\-documented for clean account ownership transfers.
* Client delivery and internal R\&D priorities are effectively balanced and coordinated.

**Requirements and Expectations**
---------------------------------


* 5\+ years of experience leading complex, cross\-functional programs in biotech, pharma, life sciences, CRO/CDMO, healthcare technology, or a similarly technical client\-delivery

jobs.title: IT Project Manager, Helen Diller Hospital
jobs.description:
The IT Project Manager, Helen Diller Hospital will lead planning, coordination, and execution of specific IT workstreams supporting the Helen Diller Hospital project, a multi\-year, large\-scale capital initiative. This role will manage the technology delivery through defined project framework processes and methodologies involving clinical applications, infrastructure, and end\-user systems to ensure alignment with hospital operational readiness and strategic goals. Responsibilities include managing scope, schedule, budget, resources, tasks, risks, deliverables, and dependencies across diverse stakeholder groups; facilitating decision\-making between IT, construction, and clinical leadership; and ensuring regulatory, security, and patient safety requirements are met. Monitors assigned project workstreams from initiation through completion. Organizes and leads activities relating to the management and completion of projects.


As an IT Project Manager for the Helen Diller Hospital project, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the next generation of healthcare delivery. This position is responsible for planning and implementing fully integrated IT solutions to support the new Helen Diller Hospital at Parnassus Heights. The work involves implementing IT services that are future\-ready, adaptable to emerging technologies, and capable of supporting smooth transitions over time.


This role requires an understanding of institutional, medical center, and systemwide priorities, as well as long\-term strategic goals. You will lead and manage complex IT workstreams with broad institutional impact, requiring sophisticated analysis, cross\-functional collaboration, and innovative problem\-solving.


The new 15\-story, 875,000 gross\-square\-foot (GSF) hospital will enable UCSF to provide much\-needed capacity for additional acute, emergency and intensive care beds, meet the state’s seismic requirements, and provide an optimal healing environment that addresses social, psychological, spiritual, and behavioral components of health in one place. The holistic focus on the needs of patients reflects UCSF’s integrated research, education and care delivery mission at Parnassus Heights. The new hospital will incorporate the latest innovations in technology and equipment for advanced complex care and bridge scientific research discoveries from bench to bedside leading to accelerated innovative treatments and therapies to benefit patients.


UCSF Health is a growing regional health system that includes UCSF Medical Center, the top\-ranked hospital in California and among the top five nationally, according to U.S. News \& World Report. The new hospital will be embedded within a campus that includes leading clinicians and scientists focused on translating discoveries into treatments and cures. UCSF Helen Diller Medical Center is part of a planned broader revitalization of the Parnassus Heights campus that also will modernize facilities supporting our research and education priorities.


As a member of the multi\-disciplinary UCSF Health IT team, you will be at the front line of creating the next generation of healthcare delivery. It involves a deep understanding of health care business capabilities, planned stakeholder experiences and journeys, technology, and proven project management methodologies.


To ensure a successful opening, the UCSF HDH IT Working Committee will define and prioritize opportunities to test new technologies and workflows that can be deployed earlier in existing hospitals. Through this continuous learning approach, you will help prepare our frontline staff and operations, and design for patients and families a seamless care experience between UCSF Health and partner care facilities, as well as pre\- and post\-procedure at home.  



**Department Overview**

UCSF Health IT is responsible for all aspects of clinical and business software applications, informatics, and AI for UCSF Health hospitals, practices, affiliates, and community partners. This includes the Electronic Health Record (APeX), which supports the clinical, revenue cycle, and clinical operational functions of the health system and its affiliates, and approximately 95 other software applications involved in patient care and operations.


The HDH Sr. IT Project Manager must be able to adhere to and emulate the Health IT culture and core values as stated below:


“People First: Patients are healthier and families happier with clinical systems to support them. Our solutions enable providers and staff to pioneer care, train the next generation of clinical leaders, and secure UCSF’s future. We use talent, creativity, and diverse skillsets to tackle tough problems. We strive to be proactive, and make time to innovate, appreciate and connect. When something big is needed, we deliver.  



**Health IT Core Values include:**

**Judgment:** Makes wise decisions, identifies root causes, thinks strategically, and prioritizes what to do now and what can be improved later.  



**Communication:** Listens well, is concise and articulate in speech and writing, treats people with respect independent of their status, and maintains calm poise in stressful situations.  



**Impact:** Accomplishes amazing amounts of important work, colleagues can rely upon you, focuses on results,


exhibits bias\-to\-action, and avoids analysis\-paralysis  



**Innovation:** Finds practical solutions to hard problems, suggests better approaches and new ideas that prove useful, and stays nimble by minimizing complexity and finding time to simplify.  



**Collaboration:** Understands that work cannot be accomplished solely as an individual contributor; works through others to develop holistic solutions that meet our customer needs and the goals of the organization.


  
**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a related field and/or equivalen

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human\-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard — from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next\-generation safety and entertainment features. Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale.


ABOUT THE TEAM


At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. We create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. From breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design and next\-generation safety, we’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard.


You will join the Autonomous Vehicle (AV) Program Management Office (PMO), a core pillar responsible for driving launch readiness for AV and ADAS features across L1–L4 autonomy. Based in the heart of Silicon Valley and Michigan, our team bridges the gap between cutting\-edge software innovation and world\-class automotive manufacturing, driving GM’s mission of Zero Crashes, Zero Congestion.  



**THE ROLE**

As a Staff Program Manager for the next generation of Super Cruise, you will be the primary orchestrator for the evolution of GM’s flagship autonomous driving technology. Operating out of our Michigan or Sunnyvale hubs, you will act as the critical link between Product Management, Technical and Vehicle Program Management, Software Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Systems Engineering, Safety, Design and all other internal stakeholders to drive the strategic goals of the AV organization.


This is a high\-visibility role. You aren't just tracking tasks; you are ensuring seamless coordination across all involved teams in order to drive high\-quality milestone plans, navigate complex trade\-offs, and ensure on\-time execution of our most advanced safety\-critical systems.  



**WHAT YOU'LL DO (RESPONSIBILITIES)**

* Build trusting partnerships with Product, Program and Engineering leader s to synchronize Super Cruise development with hardware/software cycles and provide critical insights on program status, dependencies, and strategic trade\-offs.
* Draft and track Program Milestones with clear success criteria, integrating guidance from Product Requirement Documents, Vehicle Program rollout plans, and company\-wide software release schedules.
* Drive and coordinate progress towards major cross\-functional program milestones in collaboration with Engineering Leads
* Own the Program Risk Register and coordinate the resolution of critical bottlenecks; proactively identify systemic risks early and facilitate the development of robust mitigation plans.
* Lead recurring Program, Risk, and Milestone Reviews while acting as a PMO SME to coach and guide peers on industry best practices, GM\-specific processes and professional excellence.
* Manage the centralized Jira Align/Jira/Confluence ecosystem and facilitate the adoption of new operational rhythms to provide executive\-level reporting and data\-driven insights to senior leadership.
* Forecast resource needs and ensure all workstreams strictly comply with necessary standards and safety\-critical software development practices.
* Ability to occasionally travel to Michigan or California locations if needed .
**YOUR SKILLS \& ABILITIES (REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS)**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering , Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* 10\+ years of relevant experience in (Technical) Program Management or Engineering in the Tech, Automotive or Aerospace industry.
* 5\+ years leading AV programs driving incremental delivery from inception to launch.
* Technical fluency in AV/ADAS platforms, including familiarity with AI\-based driving models, simulation, validation, sensors, compute, infrastructure and operations.
* Expertise in agile and waterfall methodologies; fluent with tools like Jira, Jira Align, Confluence, and Microsoft 365\.
* Experience working on software and hardware delivery within Automotive OEM vehicle development processes.
* Capacity to thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment and effectively manage competing priorities.
* Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills with a proven track record of driving alignment among senior executive stakeholders and inspiring diverse, cross\-functional teams to deliver change through influence without direct authority.
* Ability to travel and operate a motor vehicle on a regular basis.
**WHAT WILL GIVE YOU A COMPETITIVE EDGE (PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS)**

* Master’s degree in Engineering or MBA.
* Experience with Software\-Defined\-Vehicle architectures.
* Familiarity with systems engineering principles, validation cycles, and safety standards relevant to autonomous domains.
* Background in scaling operational systems and processes to support evolving technology roadmaps and launch targets.
* Understanding of GM’s GxDP (Global Vehicle/Software Development Process).
* Experience managing to GM’s VeSCoM (Vehicle Software Control Management) timing and Program Increments (PI).
* PMP, CSM, SAFe , Six Sigma, ISO 26262 or similar certifications

**About Us**
------------



We are Sila, a next\-generation battery materials company. Our mission is to power the world's transition to clean energy. To create this future, our team is building a better lithium\-ion battery from the inside out today. We engineer and manufacture ground\-breaking battery materials that significantly increase the energy density of batteries, while reducing their size and weight. The result? Smaller more powerful batteries that can unlock innovation in consumer devices and accelerate the mass adoption of electric cars to eliminate our dependence on fossil fuels. We're tackling one of the biggest challenges of our time every day, and together we're redefining what's possible. Are you ready to be a part of a team committed to changing the world?

**Who You Are**
---------------



Sila is seeking a high\-impact NPI Program Manager to lead new battery cell product development and qualification with key manufacturing partners. Positioned at the intersection of internal R\&D, operations, and external suppliers, you will drive high\-velocity execution to deliver mass\-production\-ready cell products.


**Responsibilities and Duties**
-------------------------------


**Strategic NPI \& Partner Management**


* Lead end\-to\-end NPI execution, driving qualification for new suppliers and external manufacturing partners (OEMs).
* Manage cross\-border partner relationships, navigating cross\-cultural and organizational dynamics to keep programs on schedule.
* Coordinate cross\-functional deliverables between R\&D, Product Management, Operations, and Quality.

Overview:

Shimmick, via our subsidiary Axia Electric, is seeking an experienced and results\-driven **Electrical Project Manager** in Northern California/Bay Area/East Bay region to lead the successful execution of electrical construction projects from contract award through closeout. This role carries full responsibility for the overall performance of assigned projects, including safety, financial outcomes, schedule adherence, client satisfaction, and team leadership.  

The Project Manager acts as the primary representative of Axia Electric to the client and is accountable for delivering projects that meet or exceed contractual obligations while aligning with company goals and standards.  

At Axia Electric, we are problem solvers. Creative thinkers. Innovators. We approach each project with fresh ideas and big thinking in pursuit of better answers, better outcomes, and better experiences for our clients. We are resourceful, nimble and resilient. We work hard together—and with our clients—to deliver high\-quality projects that are on time, on budget and beyond expectations. **Axia Electric**
Since the early 1990s, Shimmick has been self\-performing electrical scopes for infrastructure projects. In 2025 the Electrical Division rebranded to Axia Electric, a subsidiary to Shimmick Construction. Axia offers electrical, instrumentation, and process controls expertise for water and wastewater treatment; dams and locks; mass transit and rail; alternative energy; power generation and transmission; and commercial building projects. Our ability to self\-perform this specialty offers additional value and enables us to better control cost and schedule for projects with major electrical and process mechanical scopes. Our clients include municipalities, water districts, sanitation districts, transit agencies, private developers, DOTs, and USACE  

Axia Electric, headquartered in Riverside, California, focuses on large public owners in several states, across water resources, water treatment, transportation and transit markets. Over the past decade, the division has grown tremendously, securing major projects, including the $350 million North City Pure Water Facility in San Diego and the $235 million EVMWD Regional Water Reclamation Facility Expansion Project in Lake Elsinore, CA.

 **Why Axia Electric**


At Axia Electric, Project Managers play a critical role in driving our reputation for excellence. This position offers the opportunity to lead impactful projects, build meaningful client relationships, and contribute directly to the company’s growth and success.  


Responsibilities:

The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to the following: **Project Leadership \& Execution*** Lead all aspects of project operations, including planning, execution, monitoring, and closeout
* Ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with contract requirements
* Oversee project setup, procurement, subcontracting, and resource allocation
* Identify and proactively manage risks, including cost exposure, schedule delays, and scope changes

**Safety \& Compliance*** Champion a strong safety culture and ensure adherence to all company and regulatory safety standards
* Ensure the safety and wellbeing of all employees, subcontractors, and partners on assigned projects

**Financial Management*** Maintain full accountability for project financial performance, including forecasting, cost control, and profitability
* Safeguard company funds, assets, and resources
* Manage project budgets, change orders, billing, and cash flow
* Evaluate and mitigate financial risks associated with project execution

**Client \& Stakeholder Management*** Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, building and maintaining strong, long\-term relationships
* Ensure client satisfaction through consistent communication, responsiveness, and delivery excellence
* Represent Axia Electric professionally in all client interactions
* Support business development by identifying opportunities for repeat and future work

**Team Leadership \& Coordination*** Lead cross\-functional project teams including field personnel, engineers, subcontractors, and vendors
* Provide clear direction, mentorship, and performance oversight to project team members
* Coordinate effectively with internal departments such as estimating, procurement, and operations

**Project Complexity \& Risk Management*** Successfully manage projects across varying levels of financial risk and operational complexity
* Assess and adapt management approach based on factors such as:
	+ Contract value and project duration
	+ Scope and technical complexity
	+ Availability of proven methods or technologies
	+ Environmental, safety, and working conditions
	+ Labor, subcontractor, or joint venture requirements
	+ Contractual risks including liquidated damages, guarantees, and liabilities
* Ensure appropriate planning and execution strategies are applied based on project profile
  


Qualifications:
**Minimum Requirements:*** Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field \+ 6 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.

**Preferred Qualifications:*** 10\+ years of experience managing or supporting complex heavy civil or industrial electrical construction projects
* Experience working in underground, confined, or highly regulated environments (e.g., transit systems or similar infrastructure)
* Background in water/wastewater, transportation, or power\-related infrastructure projects
* Strong understanding of electrical power distribution and control systems, including switchgear, transformers, generators, and backup power systems
* Ability to read and interpret complex drawings and schematics (single\-line diagrams, P\&IDs, control systems, and coordination plans)
* Experience with installation, testing, and commissioning of electrical and instrumentation/c

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------



We are Sila, a next\-generation battery materials company. Our mission is to power the world's transition to clean energy. To create this future, our team is building a better lithium\-ion battery from the inside out today. We engineer and manufacture ground\-breaking battery materials that significantly increase the energy density of batteries, while reducing their size and weight. The result? Smaller more powerful batteries that can unlock innovation in consumer devices and accelerate the mass adoption of electric cars to eliminate our dependence on fossil fuels. We're tackling one of the biggest challenges of our time every day, and together we're redefining what's possible. Are you ready to be a part of a team committed to changing the world?

**Who You Are**
---------------



Sila's Program Managers act as the "flight control tower" for our critical, multi\-year integrated programs. This leadership role bridges R\&D, engineering, capital project, and commercial workstreams to ensure complex products scale smoothly from lab to market. You aren't executing the functional tasks—you are orchestrating the sequencing, integration, and high\-stakes decision\-making required to land our strategic objectives safely, on time, and in\-line with target financial metrics.


**Responsibilities and Duties**
-------------------------------


* **Integrated Leadership:** Drive major cross\-functional programs linking R\&D (materials/equipment/battery development), Operations (manufacturing), Capital Projects (manufacturing scale\-up), and Product \+ Commercial teams (customer "Plans to Win").
* **Workflow Architect:** Design and communicate workflows to resolve complex uncertainties and decisions. Maintain the "single source of truth" (integrated databases and governance tools) to keep objectives, metrics, and technical data synchronized across functions.
* **Execution \& Sequencing:** Optimize the timing of R\&D breakthroughs, scale\-up projects, and commercial milestones to hit financial and strategic targets (e.g., revenue run rate, ROIC).
* **Executive Communication \& Partnership:** Serve as the central point of accountability for program health, working closely with the Exec Sponsor and Steering Team to steward the program's direction and approach. Deliver crisp status updates, risk assessments, and roadblock resolutions to executives and collaborators. Lead and participate in company\-wide, cross\-program prioritization efforts.
* **Decision \& Risk Management:** Lead execs and functional managers through high\-stakes decisions (e.g., project scoping, partner selection) and proactively mitigate cross\-program dependencies before they impact timelines.

**Knowledge and Skill Requirements**
------------------------------------


* + **Industry Experience:** 10\+ years in battery technology, automotive, chemical process, semiconductor, oil \& gas, or a similarly complex hardware\-plus\-process industry.
	+ **Program Leadership:** 5\+ years leading complex technical and/or business programs that integrate R\&D, manufacturing scale\-up, and commercial execution.
	+ **Scale\-up Expertise:** Proven experience transferring novel technology and/or products from R\&D into high\-volume manufacturing environments.
	+ **Education:** Bachelor's degree or higher in an Engineering or Physical Science field.
	+ **Program Management Fundamentals SME:** Deep, demonstrable expertise in core program and project management disciplines—including decision quality, scheduling, budgeting, project framing, financial analysis, risk communication and analysis, and resource allocation.
	+ **Systemic Program Architect:** Proven ability to navigate a matrix model, ensuring functional activities support macro program objectives without duplicating effort.
	+ **Master Communicator:** Skilled at distilling complex technical, financial, and commercial data into clear, actionable insights for diverse audiences.
	+ **Strategic Influence:** Adept at driving alignment among executives and SMEs, escalating effectively, and balancing technical risks with business objectives.
	+ **New Product Introduction \& Tech Transfer Mastery:** Strong understanding of Stage\-Gate methodologies, with the ability to leverage Agile or Waterfall frameworks depending on the workflow.
	+ **Ambiguity Management:** Comfortable driving execution and maintaining momentum especially in the face of uncertainties, when strategies shift, or deliverables are fluid.

**Physical Demands and Working Conditions**
-------------------------------------------


* Ability to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) including safety glasses, lab coats, and steel\-toe shoes when visiting laboratory or manufacturing environments.
* Ability to work at a computer for extended periods.


The starting base pay for this role is between $168,000 and $212,000 at the time of posting. The actual base pay depends on many factors, such as education, experience, and skills. Base pay is only one part of Sila's competitive Total Rewards package that can include benefits, perks, equity, and bonuses. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.



\#LI\-PL1 \#LI\-Onsite



**Working at Sila**
-------------------



We believe that building a diverse team at Sila helps us amplify our individual talents. We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive environment where good ideas are free to come from anyone. We are proud to celebrate diversity and all qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, national origin, or any other status protected by law.

Thermometrics, Telaire, Protimeter, NovaSensor and Kaye are industry\-leading sensor and measurement brands that are proudly part of Amphenol Sensors. Together, these businesses develop highly specialized technologies used across automotive, industrial, medical, environmental, and validation applications. Customers turn to our teams for deep expertise, rapid customization, and proven global manufacturing capabilities—helping them solve their toughest engineering challenges.
  
  

Amphenol Sensors— a subsidiary of the Amphenol Corporation, a member of the Fortune 500 (NYSE: APH). Established in 1932, Amphenol has pioneered innovation in electronics for nearly a century. Amphenol is the central hub of cutting\-edge electronic solutions across virtually every end market, including Automotive, Broadband Communications, Commercial Aerospace, Industrial, Information Technology and Data Communications, Defense, Mobile Devices, and Mobile Networks.
  
  

Our unique, decentralized organizational structure fosters entrepreneurial leadership and drives excellent performance. We manage locally, enabling us to move at the speed of a small business, with the financial stability and global resources of an industry\-leading, international company.
  
  

WHO WE ARE
  
At NovaSensor, an Amphenol company, we are pioneers in high accuracy sensing solutions. As a global leader in MEMS (Microelectromechanical Systems) technology, we design and manufacture advanced pressure sensors that power critical applications across the medical, automotive, industrial, and consumer markets—whether it's enabling life\-saving medical devices, enhancing vehicle safety and efficiency, or ensuring reliability in industrial systems.
  
We are part of Amphenol, a global leader in advanced interconnect systems, serving diverse markets including automotive, aerospace, industrial, and mobile devices. Amphenol Corporation, a member of the Fortune 500 (NYSE: APH), was established in 1932 and has pioneered innovation in electronics for nearly a century across virtually every end market.

In your role as Project Manager for Amphenol NovaSensor you will be responsible for planning and managing new product and customer development projects from conception to product launch and play an important role in the growth of our business.
  
  

WHAT YOU WILL DO
  
* Lead projects from business award through start of production, ensuring on\-time, on\-budget, and high\-quality delivery.

* Bachelor of Science in an Engineering discipline

**About the role**
------------------



Muon seeks a Senior Program Manager \- Microwave to lead Muon Space's Microwave Program efforts, responsible for successfully delivering solutions, products, and technology while managing cost and schedule baselines with the U.S. Government and Commercial Organizations. The Program Manager will be a key member of the Mission Engineering team and collaborate closely with Muon Space's engineering, business, legal, finance, and operations departments. You will also support the portfolio's growth by fostering organic growth on existing contracts and supporting captures of new contracts.



As a Technical Program Manager at Muon Space, you delight our customers and users with high\-quality products and solutions delivered on time and on budget, meeting our contractual obligations. You are cognizant of how all the pieces need to come together for successful program execution and can turn that into well\-organized roadmaps, schedules, and budgets that you then track throughout the program lifecycle. You will be responsible for monitoring and ensuring successful execution of Muon's contracts that you manage. You will support business development through proposals, RFI responses, customer engagement, and organic growth.



This role is based in San Jose with a hybrid schedule (3 days per week in\-office), but may be worked remotely from an approved location.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Lead a multidisciplinary aerospace development effort, driving day\-to\-day execution of the program
* Engage with internal and external stakeholders to plan and coordinate the resources necessary to execute the program
* Synchronize a diverse technical team by establishing tools, practices, and process
* Participate in technical discussions, ask probing questions, and work with the team to pull together scoping, schedules, and solutions to issues
* Track and report program metrics on schedule, resource, cost, risk, and technical performance
* Serve as the face of the company to customers, subcontractors and suppliers

**Qualifications**
------------------


* 5\+ years relevant experience in program management
* B.S. in an engineering discipline, M.S. or Ph.D. preferred

jobs.title: Data Center Program Manager
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Web Services is seeking a detail oriented, customer obsessed Program Manager for its Infrastructure Operations team.
  

  

Our Program Managers are able to quickly adapt strategies, plans and solutions in response to dynamic business requirements. They also must be comfortable interfacing and driving various functional teams and individuals at all levels of the organization. If you have previous project engineering experience, are ready to take on challenges, open minded, appreciate team comradely, have an occasional sense of humor and want to help Amazon raise the bar, then this role is for you!  

  

Successful candidates are natural self\-starters who possess the ability to design, develop and deploy innovative solutions to address operational challenges while driving these solutions to completion. This role requires both independent contribution as well as the ability to work within multi\-disciplinary teams (internal operations, engineering, legal, finance, procurement, environmental/health/safety, etc.). This individual has strong communication skills, is organized and thrive in ambiguity.
  

  

The scope of role encompasses program management of capital expense (CAPEX) and/or operational expense (OPEX) projects within data center operations. The scope of projects will include but not be limited to the improvement of electrical, mechanical, fire detection, building improvements, vendor (partner) management, and cluster wide maintenance coordination. An understanding of these systems is necessary, as the individual will be expected to identify areas for improvement as well as act on data provided from other teams and organizations.  

  

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

PDX is an AWS GovCloud region. As required by our contracts with the federal government, effective February 24, 2026, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States).  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Manage requirements, budget, design, and implementation of assigned projects

Identify and communicate needs for design improvements.

Lead and coordinate design and execution efforts between internal teams and outside partners including equipment specifications, material flow, process design, and site layout.  

  

Evaluate project risks and issues and propose actionable resolutions.  

  

Build strong working relationships with data center leadership teams across multiple sites as well as other internal stakeholders (operations, finance, safety, security, legal, procurement).  

  

General knowledge of data center operations and facility management.  

  

Track record for being detail\-oriented with a demonstrated ability to self\-motivate and follow\-through on projects  

  

Ability to follow accurate and complete support procedures, system documentation, and issue tracking entries.  

  

Proactively and continually improve your level of knowledge about data center relevant technologies.
  

  

About the team  

Why AWS  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Diverse Experiences  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

jobs.title: Product Risk Program Manager

As a Specialized Assessment Product Risk Program Manager (SA PRPM), you will be a critical driver in Meta’s risk management and product integrity efforts. You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy—proactively identifying important problems, exercising independent judgment, and contributing to the strategy and roadmap for cross\-functional risk review. Experience with product launches, 0* 1 products, emerging technologies, or novel product capabilities
