new_jobs.title: ML Data Operations Lead, Dataset Release and Delivery - Autonomous Vehicles
new_jobs.description:
NVIDIA is redefining the automotive industry through accelerated computing, artificial intelligence, simulation, and full\-stack autonomous vehicle development. The pace and quality of AV development depend on delivering the right sensor, ground\-truth, and derived data to machine learning teams reliably, transparently, and at scale. It's truly the data that makes the cars drive!


The AV MLOps Dataset Release team transforms large\-scale automotive data into versioned, trustworthy datasets used to train and evaluate machine learning models across the autonomous\-driving stack. We are seeking an ML Data Operations Lead to own the customer\-facing operational lifecycle of these releases. In this role, you will work at the intersection of machine learning, data engineering, infrastructure, and release operations. You will partner with ML engineers to understand their data needs, translate those needs into actionable release requirements, coordinate execution with the engineering team, and ensure every release is delivered with clear validation, documentation, and communication. This is a senior individual\-contributor role. It requires sufficient technical depth to investigate problems, assess delivery risk, and challenge unclear requirements, while focusing primarily on operational ownership rather than developing the underlying data pipelines.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Serve as the primary operational partner for ML engineers and other internal consumers of AV datasets.
* Capture and clarify dataset release requirements, including intended use cases, required signals and labels, data volumes, release cadence, delivery timelines, storage destinations, and acceptance criteria.
* Be responsible for the release calendar and coordinate priorities, dependencies, engineering readiness, and compute capacity across multiple concurrent dataset\-release tracks.
* Monitor production release workflows from launch through delivery. Identify failures, stalled tasks, resource constraints, missing data, and other risks, then bring together the appropriate engineers and infrastructure owners to drive resolution.
* Validate release results against expected volumes, signals, versions, and quality criteria before communicating availability to customers.
* Maintain timely, accurate communication with customers regarding release status, risks, incidents, changing estimates, and recovery plans.
* Produce release notes, delivery announcements, known\-issue documentation, and handoff information that enable ML teams to understand and use each dataset confidently.

**What we need to see:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 6\+ years of experience in ML data operations, technical service delivery, dataset operations, release operations, technical program execution, or another data\-intensive operational role.
* Solid understanding of the machine learning data lifecycle, including data collection, curation, labeling, validation, versioning, release, storage, and consumption by training or evaluation pipelines.
* Ability to use SQL and data\-analysis tools to investigate dataset contents, reconcile expected and delivered results, and identify quality or completeness issues.
* Strong customer orientation and skill in translating between ML engineers, data specialists, infrastructure teams, and other technical collaborators.
* Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to produce detailed requirements, release notes, status updates, incident summaries, and operating procedures.
* Excellent judgment when balancing customer timelines, engineering capacity, system reliability, data quality, and competing release priorities.
* Proven track record of influencing without direct authority and driving work to completion across a highly matrixed organization.
* Comfort operating in a fast\-moving environment where requirements, data availability, and technical constraints may change quickly.

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Experience operating large\-scale dataset generation, materialization, validation, or delivery workflows, especially for autonomous\-driving, ADAS, robotics, or computer\-vision systems.
* Familiarity with automotive sensor and ground\-truth data, including camera, lidar, radar, mapping, calibration, or multimodal datasets.
* Hands\-on experience with Python, notebooks, Databricks, dashboards, or lightweight automation used to investigate data and improve operational workflows.
* Experience defining service\-level objectives, operational metrics, alerting, incident\-management practices, and root\-cause corrective actions.
* A track record of converting frequently repeated customer requests or operational problems into standardized, automated, and scalable services.


NVIDIA brings together some of the most skilled and creative people in technology to solve problems that were once considered impossible. You will have the opportunity to work with teams advancing autonomous vehicles, artificial intelligence, accelerated computing, and large\-scale data systems while directly improving the speed and reliability of machine learning development.

**Primary Responsibilities:**  

Serve as the single, authoritative point of contact for all COR communications, ensuring timely, accurate, and professional responses to Government inquiries, direction, and feedback throughout the life of the task order.

Gracey Care is a telehealth practice helping seniors 65\+ age comfortably at home. We partner with home care agencies and senior living communities to provide Medicare\-reimbursed care management — chronic care coordination, medication reconciliation, and specialist follow\-ups. We take on the clinical coordination that caregivers and families would otherwise have to manage themselves, so they can focus on being present with their loved ones.

AthenaOne experience is required. You need to be comfortable scheduling appointments, performing check\-in and check\-out, verifying insurance, and messaging patients through the platform from day one.

*Nice to Have*

* Spruce knowledge for secure patient messaging

* Stripe payment processing

* Bilingual English/Spanish is a big plus

**Tools You'll Use**

Daily: Slack, Zoom, Google Drive, Microsoft Excel, Claude/ChatGPT Clinical \& Billing: AthenaOne, Spruce, Adobe Acrobat, Stripe Insurance Portals: Noridian Medicare Part B, AHCCCS, Availity

* Direct experience with:

* Prior authorizations

* Medicare Part D / specialty pharmacy workflows
* Commercial and Medicare insurance plans
* Coordination with provider offices and patients

new_jobs.description:
**About CCNC**


From the mountains to the coast, from large cities to small towns, Community Care of North Carolina is transforming health care. Informed by statewide data and predictive analytics, community\-based care\-managers work with local physicians and diverse teams of health professionals to develop whole\-person plans of care that connect people to the right local resources and increase equity and access to high quality care.

 **CCNC Mission Statement**


To improve the health and quality of life for all North Carolinians by building supporting better community\-based healthcare delivery systems.

 **Position Summary**


The Call Center Coordinator is responsible for telephonic outreach and screening of identified members based on plan stratification for care management with a call center approach. Call Center staff also monitor for incoming calls, process referrals, and assist with any questions or needs identified. An experienced and energetic communicator, the coordinator is focused on deepening program participation as well as making members aware of CCNC (plan) programs and offerings.

  

The Call Center Coordinator interacts with members, providers, and other staff to initiate program interventions, document activities, and refer risk appropriate members to professional staff according to protocols. The candidate for this position must have a disposition towards good customer service, be assertive without being aggressive, and always maintain a professional demeanor.


The Call Center Coordinator will work remotely to cover needs across the state.

**Essential Functions**
-----------------------

* Conduct continual telephonic outreach to identified and referred members focused on engaging members with care management services.
* Receive/retrieve and manage referrals from callers and/or data reports, linking members with care management needs as identified.
* Complete and document member screenings tools and refer clinical needs to most appropriate clinical care management team member for assessment and follow up.
* Verify demographic information.
* Send educational materials, welcome letters, and/or other resources to members, as necessary.
* Assist to identify and address Social Determinant of Health needs.
* Assist with guidance in scheduling medical appointments and transportation as needed.
* Provide information on community resources.
* Assist member with care coordination of resource needs and health care system navigation.
* Provide culturally appropriate general education and information.
* Meet monthly productivity and role expectations.
* Complete all assignments within expected timeframes.
* Perform other duties that assist in keeping the operations organized and functioning as needed.
* Notify supervisor promptly of any issues with receiving or sending referrals, making timely care management assignments, or issues with carrying out any other duties assigned.
* Collaborate with the Care Team to address barriers and create efficiencies with processes
* Abide by department guidelines, company policies, and HIPAA regulations.
* Attend departmental and corporate meetings.
* Understand and uphold CCNC goals, objectives, and standards.
* Perform all other duties as requested.
 **Qualifications**

* High School Diploma/ or GED
* Prior telephonic call center experience desired
* Minimum of two years previous work experience, preferably in a healthcare setting
* Healthcare experience and medical terminology knowledge highly preferred
* Bilingual preferred
* Managed care experience a plus
**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**
------------------------------------

* Computer skills required including various office software and the internet; experience with MS Office software preferred
* Strong initiative and attention to detail
* Performance metric driven and productivity mindset
* Strong oral and written communication proficiency
* Organizational and time management skills
* Strong interpersonal and critical thinking skills; team\-oriented
* Resourceful \- able to shift strategy or approach in response to the demands of a situation
* Adaptable \- responds to change with a positive attitude and a willingness to learn new ways to accomplish work activities and objectives
* Motivational interviewing skills
* Knowledge of Care Management principles
* Ability to work independently, multi\-task, and to use sound judgment when needed
* Outgoing and energetic attitude; respectful customer service skills
* Ability to provide information in a manner that is culturally and linguistically appropriate
* Knowledge of and experience working in member or clinical data systems
**Working Conditions**
----------------------

* Routinely there may be some minor physical inconveniences or discomforts in the work setting, including sitting for moderate periods of time
* Must be able to utilize office equipment, computer, keyboard, and phone with or without assistive devices
* Repetitive wrist motion and occasional lifting/carrying of up to 25 pounds
* Hands\-on clinical treatment is not permitted when performing duties for the organization
* The job environment is a home environment
* The job environment can be intense as high volume, repetitive work is an expectation
 **Why Join Us**

* Make a meaningful impact on youth and families across North Carolina
* Work with a supportive and collaborative care team
* Competitive Benefits Package effective first day of employment
* Opportunities for growth, training, and bonus incentives\*
 **Ready to improve the health and quality of life of all North Carolinians by building and supporting better community\-based health care delivery systems?**

* **Apply today and join us in delivering compassionate care that makes a difference.**
Benefits:  


* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional developme

new_jobs.title: Customer Support Specialist I

This is a remote position.

  

  

The **Customer Support Specialist** is the friendly, patient, and detail\-oriented first point of contact for all incoming application support requests. In this role, you’ll provide prompt, courteous assistance to end\-users, ensuring every interaction is handled with professionalism and care. You’ll follow established procedures to gather information, document issues, and resolve or escalate requests as needed—all while maintaining a steady, reliable approach.  

  

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**  

  



The essential duties and responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to the following:  

  

* Respond to and provide friendly, patient, and professional customer service for all incoming calls, emails, and online requests for basic application support or technical assistance in a timely and courteous manner.
* Gather essential information needed by the Support Services Specialist to accurately triage and troubleshoot customer inquiries.
* Document, assign, and track service requests accurately using support tools and systems.
* Develop a working knowledge and growing proficiency in the application, leveraging its features to accurately diagnose and resolve customer issues.
* Always maintain a high level of customer service and professionalism.
* Participate in team meetings and training sessions as required.
Other duties as assigned by supervisor.  
* 

**Advanced****Duties and Responsibilities**  

  



* Provide step\-by\-step guidance using provided documentation or scripts to help end\-users resolve common issues.
Follow established procedures and scripts to troubleshoot application and/or technical issues for hardware, software, or network issues.  
* 
  

  

### **Requirements**


**Minimum Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities)**  

  



* High school diploma or equivalent.
* 3 years’ work experience in a customer service\-oriented role.
* Strong troubleshooting skills.
* Has the demonstrated ability to follow and participate in technical discussions; technically savvy.
* Strong interpersonal and team building skills.
* Effective organization and time management skills.
Ability to work independently and within a team environment.  
* 

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  



* Associate’s degree in computer science, computer programming, computer information systems, or database administration, or closely related field.
* Certifications in the IT field is highly preferred.
* 5 years professional work experience in application or technical support.
* Professional work experience in healthcare industry, medical billing, or accounting highly preferred.
Excellent understanding of the fundamentals of network, server, and desktop administration, installations, upgrades, techniques, tools, and equipment.  
* 
  

  

### **Benefits**

  

  

Fully Remote Workforce
As a virtual\-first organization, we can attract the best talent no matter where we all live. This allows for added flexibility and a schedule that works for you.  

  

Essential Benefits  

  

We offer medical, dental, and vision insurance; 40l(k) with match; legal benefits; short\-term and long\-term disability coverage; life insurance; and paid time off.  

  

Employee Recognition  

  

Team members can reward each other with points to celebrate everyday wins and going above and beyond. It’s our way of saying “nice job” in a way that really sticks.  

  

Financial Incentives  

  

Employees can benefit financially through the company’s success, referring top talent, and performance\-based bonuses.  

  

  

  

**Salary**: $42,000 \- $48,000
  

**Schedule**: Monday \- Friday, 40 hours per week, occasional weekend hours

new_jobs.title: Customer Support Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**About BarnTools LLC**


BarnTools is a rapidly growing, innovative AgTech startup seeking to improve the swine and poultry industries by bringing technology into animal agriculture. Our mission is to connect and collect data from all livestock and poultry farms across the globe to help growers, producers, and packers have the data they need to run safe and efficient operations. We currently offer a wireless remote monitoring system for agricultural facilities that is built upon an IoT platform with mobile and web applications, and a SaaS business model.

  

BarnTools was founded by and built by producers for producers to solve our own challenges on our family farms. Our customers are farmers and large integrators. Headquartered in Urbandale, IA, our culture is built on teamwork and trust. We are a remote\-friendly company looking for energetic, high achievers looking to make an impact in the animal agriculture industry.

  

We are looking for a Customer Support Specialist familiar with agriculture and experienced in Customer Support and Success within a SaaS company. We have both an e\-commerce hardware as well as a SaaS component to our business model. You will report to the Manager of Customer Support. This can be a fully remote position or you could work from our headquarters in Urbandale, Iowa.

new_jobs.title: Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
**Position Summary**


Adeptus Solutions, Inc. is seeking a Business Analyst to support technology and software development initiatives within a SAFe Agile environment. The Business Analyst will work closely with stakeholders, Product Management, developers, QA, Scrum Masters, and project leadership to understand business needs, analyze processes, capture business rules, and translate requirements into actionable Agile work items in Azure DevOps (ADO).
The ideal candidate can bridge the gap between business and technical teams by turning complex business processes and requirements into clear, testable, and traceable features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation.
**Key Responsibilities**
* Elicit, analyze, validate, and document business and technical requirements throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Map and document current\-state and future\-state business processes, including workflows, decision points, actors, system interactions, and dependencies.
* Identify, document, and maintain business rules, policies, conditions, and system behaviors that govern business processes.
* Translate business requirements, process models, and business rules into SAFe/Agile features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and ADO work items.
* Create and maintain requirements in Azure DevOps (ADO) and ensure work items accurately reflect approved business needs and scope.
* Decompose complex requirements into appropriately sized, actionable user stories that can be developed and tested within an iteration.
* Develop clear, measurable, and testable acceptance criteria that define expected system behavior and business outcomes.
* Maintain requirements traceability from business needs and business rules through features, user stories, development, testing, and acceptance.
* Collaborate with Product Management and Product Owners to support backlog development, prioritization, refinement, and readiness.
* Participate in SAFe PI Planning, backlog refinement, iteration planning, system demos, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.
* Facilitate requirements workshops and working sessions with business and technical stakeholders.
* Analyze requirements and processes to identify gaps, inconsistencies, dependencies, risks, and impacts.
* Work directly with developers and technical teams to clarify requirements, business rules, workflows, and expected system behavior.
* Partner with QA to ensure requirements and acceptance criteria provide a sufficient basis for test planning and validation.
* Review proposed solutions and developed functionality to verify alignment with approved requirements and business processes.
* Analyze proposed changes and document their impact on requirements, processes, functionality, scope, and downstream systems.
* Develop and maintain process flows, workflow diagrams, business rules catalogs, functional requirements, requirements traceability matrices, and other BA artifacts.
* Ensure requirements and supporting documentation remain current and synchronized with ADO and the approved product backlog.
* Identify and communicate requirements\-related risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies.
* Support continuous improvement of business analysis, requirements management, and Agile delivery practices.

  

**Skills and Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Project Management, or a related field, and four years of experience as a Business Analyst or related role.
* Demonstrated experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements, technical requirements, and business rules.
* Experience developing current\-state and future\-state process maps and documenting business workflows.
* Experience translating requirements and process analysis into features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and Agile work items.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) or a comparable requirements and Agile work\-management platform.
* Experience working within a SAFe Agile and/or Agile/Scrum environment.
* Understanding of software development lifecycles and the relationship between requirements, development, QA, deployment, and operational support.
* Strong understanding of requirements traceability and requirements management.
* Ability to analyze complex business processes and translate them into clear, actionable requirements for technical teams.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, facilitation, and critical\-thinking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to effectively communicate with business stakeholders, Product Management, Product Owners, developers, QA, Scrum Masters, and project leadership.
* Experience with process modeling and diagramming tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, or similar platforms.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with cloud technologies, APIs, system integrations, databases, data flows, or technical architectures is preferred.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* SAFe certification or demonstrated experience working within a SAFe Agile Release Train (ART).
* Experience supporting PI Planning and iteration planning.
* Experience managing and refining product backlogs in ADO.
* Experience developing business rules, process models, requirements traceability, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience working directly with software development and QA teams.
* Experience with complex technical systems, integrations, APIs, data flows, or cloud\-based applications.
* Agile, SAFe, Scrum, ITIL, PMP, or related certification.

new_jobs.title: Lead, Channel Enablement
new_jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**

‎


Commercial Organization \| GTM Enablement
  

Reports to: Director, GTM Enablement
  

  

The Lead, Channel Enablement owns the enablement strategy and infrastructure that helps Castlight\-powered solutions get sold effectively through our channel ecosystem, including health plans, strategic partners, resellers, and Marketplace relationships.
  

  

This role is the Commercial owner of the second sale enablement motion and the connective tissue across Castlight, our partners, and the teams responsible for bringing our solutions to market. The Lead builds the training, demos, tools, and repeatable programs that allow partner sellers and Castlight teams to confidently position, demonstrate, and sell Castlight\-powered solutions at scale.
  

  

The role also owns the core demo infrastructure supporting channel selling, ensuring our Figma environments, screen libraries, and partner\-specific experiences stay current as the product evolves.
‎


**How will you make an impact \& Requirements**

‎


**What You'll Own**
-------------------

**Channel \& Partner Enablement**
---------------------------------

* Build and own the channel enablement strategy across health plans, strategic partners, resellers, and Marketplace partners.
* Develop scalable enablement programs that help partner sellers understand the buyer problem, articulate the Castlight value proposition, demonstrate the solution, and advance opportunities.
* Create partner\-ready training programs, playbooks, talk tracks, FAQs, objection handling, templates, and selling tools using Product Marketing's approved positioning and messaging.
* Partner with Strategic Partnerships to build tailored enablement programs based on partner type, commercial model, seller audience, and go\-to\-market motion.
* Support the launch and ongoing readiness of new partner relationships and Castlight\-powered offerings.

**Second Sale Enablement**
--------------------------

* Own the enablement framework for the second sale motion across health plan and partner channels.
* Establish one source of truth for second sale training, demos, tools, templates, and selling standards.
* Prepare Castlight Commercial and Client teams for the transition of second sale execution to Client CSMs by September 30\.
* Build repeatable training and certification approaches that allow Client teams to execute consistently while maintaining Commercial standards.
* Create scalable processes for Commercial review, feedback, and continuous improvement as execution moves closer to the client and health plan teams.

**Demo Strategy \& Engineering**
--------------------------------

* Own the core demo environments supporting health plan, partner, reseller, and second sale motions.
* Build and maintain Figma\-based demos, screen libraries, reusable components, and partner\-specific demo experiences.
* Maintain demo environments as products, capabilities, positioning, and user experiences evolve.
* Lead Nova conversions across the existing channel book and establish the standards for new partner implementations.
* Manage partner access to demo environments and establish clear governance around version control, usage, and updates.
* Coordinate external design or Figma resources as needed to maintain and scale the demo platform.
* Establish a regular operating cadence with Product, UX, Solutions, and Product Marketing so demo experiences remain accurate and current.

**Cross\-Functional Enablement**
--------------------------------

* Translate Product Marketing's positioning and messaging into usable seller training, demos, and field tools.
* Partner with Strategic Partnerships to understand partner priorities, seller needs, and commercial opportunities.
* Partner with Client leadership to ensure second sale teams have the tools, training, and confidence required to execute.
* Partner with Solutions and Product teams to keep demonstrations accurate and identify opportunities to improve how Castlight capabilities are represented in market.
* Bring health plan, partner, seller, and field feedback back to Product Marketing, Product, Solutions, and Strategic Partnerships to improve messaging, products, and the partner experience.

**How Ownership Works**
-----------------------

This role operates across several teams, with clear ownership boundaries:


**Product Marketing** owns core positioning, messaging architecture, value propositions, competitive strategy, and master marketing assets.


**Channel Enablement** turns that strategy into training, demos, playbooks, tools, certification, and scalable seller experiences.


**Strategic Partnerships** owns partner strategy, relationships, commercial agreements, partner performance, and escalations.


**Client CSMs** own plan\-specific second sale execution, including training delivery to health plan sellers and ongoing maintenance of client\-specific materials.


**Solutions and Product** provide product expertise, roadmap input, and validation required to keep demonstrations technically accurate.


**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Partner sellers can confidently explain and demonstrate Castlight\-powered solutions without relying on Castlight for every selling interaction.
* Health plan and partner channels have consistent, current, easy\-to\-use enablement resources.
* Second sale execution successfully transitions to Client teams without losing quality or commercial consistency.
* Demo environments stay aligned with the live product and can be efficiently adapted across partners and channels.
* New partners can move from agreement to seller readiness through a repeatable enablement process.
* Feedback from partner and second sale motions consistently reaches the teams responsible for product, messaging, and commercial strategy.

------------------

* 4\+ years of experience in sales enablement, partner enablement, solutions consulting, product marketing su
